description: PB-84 is the Regional Transport Office serving the Bhawanigarh sub-division in the Sangrur district of Punjab. It functions under the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) and manages vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and road tax collections for the local jurisdiction.
address: Office of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM), Bhawanigarh, District Sangrur, Punjab
